column2: Rye eau-de-vie rested in neutral stainless-steel/amphora vessels (not wood-cask aged) from Domaine des Hautes Glaces (Isère, France) -- producer's own product page explicitly distinguishes it from aged spirits ("this is not 'ageing'...but 'resting'"), so it does not meet whisky's minimum wood-cask-ageing definition. Confirms the seed's own suspicion that the "Spirit" wording meant this might not be whisky.
